memories: 總是叫錯我名字的導師
貼在公布欄上的月考排名
memories_en: the big banyan tree at the end of the corridor
the homeroom teacher who always got my name wrong
the monthly exam rankings posted on the bulletin board

pa.zh: 值日生請現在到導師辦公室一趟。
pa.en: The student on duty, please come to the teachers' office now.

cards.title: 榕樹葉掉進走廊了
cards.whisper: 明明離樹那麼遠，葉子卻掉在腳邊。
cards.whisper_en: Far from any tree, yet leaves lie at your feet.

edits.corridor: Turn the middle fluorescent tube light dark, stretch the dark far end of the corridor into a far-too-long vanishing tunnel, and scatter a few small green banyan twigs and leaves on the wet terrazzo floor in the middle distance past the long stone sink with taps and the red bucket with mop.
edits.door: Show the central wooden door with its small square window standing ajar with a dark gap, repeat that same wooden door receding into the distance inside the dark corridor reflection on the left, and draw a wet mop trail running up the white wall beside the wooden shoe cubby with white sneakers and the brown bulletin board.
edits.office: For its first appearance, place the red mop bucket with mop standing alone in the middle of the office floor where it could not be, with a wet mop trail running up the office wall behind it and a few small green banyan leaves scattered on the floor beside it.

cards.title: 導師名牌多貼膠帶
cards.title_en: Desk cards taped out of order
cards.whisper_en: Every name is stuck under tape.

edits.corridor: Make the nearest cool-white fluorescent tube light dark and stretch the corridor beyond it into a far too long dark tunnel, leave the red bucket with the mop standing alone in the middle of the wet terrazzo floor away from the long stone sink, run a wet mop trail from the floor up the pale green wall beside the brown wooden doors, and show every brown wooden door on the right standing ajar.
edits.door: Repeat the same brown wooden door with small square window many times receding into the dark corridor on the left, show every receding wooden doorway standing ajar, leave the low wooden shoe cabinet with white sneakers in place and leave the cork bulletin board with blank white slips unchanged.
edits.office: Add on the teacher's desk a small stack of blank name cards restacked crookedly in the wrong order with extra thick layers of shiny tape across them.

cards.title: 排名紙翹起一角
cards.whisper: 只有一張紙，角先翹了起來。
cards.whisper_en: Only one slip, its corner lifts first.

edits.corridor: Turn the middle ceiling fluorescent tube light dark while the others stay lit, stretch the dark far end of the corridor to be far too long, leave every wooden door on the right standing ajar, move the red mop bucket with the mop from under the long stone sink to stand alone in the middle of the wet corridor floor, and run the wet mop trail from the floor up the pale green wall under the barred windows.
edits.door: Repeat the same wooden door with a small window many times into the distance inside the dark corridor on the left, leave the central wooden door standing ajar, and make one blank white ranking slip with no text on the brown cork bulletin board hang crooked with its corner curled up.
edits.office: For the first photo of the teachers' office, show its door left standing ajar with the duty student's red mop bucket standing alone in the middle of the office floor where it could not be, with a wet mop trail leading to it.

cards.title: 榕樹垂到走廊了
cards.whisper: 走廊盡頭，有東西垂下來了。
cards.whisper_en: At the end of the corridor, something hangs down.

edits.corridor: At the dark far end of the long corridor beyond the fluorescent tube lights, add thick low banyan branches with hanging aerial roots crowding through the end opening and brushing the wet reflective floor and side railing, with scattered banyan leaves and small twigs lying on the wet floor in the middle distance; hang a plain Taiwanese white short-sleeved school shirt with navy trim with no badge on each barred window grille on the left wall above the long stone sink.
edits.door: In front of the wooden shoe cabinet with white sneakers and the wooden classroom door, scatter small banyan twigs and leaves across the wet reflective floor, hang a plain Taiwanese white short-sleeved school shirt with navy trim with no badge on the open corridor doors visible in the left mirror-like opening, and add long faint shadows of a whole class of empty chairs stretching across the wet floor with nobody casting them.
edits.classroom: Push every wood-veneer student desk with steel legs away to leave one desk alone in the center, turn every wooden chair to face the camera with a plain Taiwanese white short-sleeved school shirt with navy trim and no badge draped over each chair back, scatter banyan leaves and a hanging banyan aerial root down through the open dark doorway on the right where a distant dark adult silhouette in light beige shirt and dark gray trousers stands with its back turned, and stack tall piles of blank exam

cards.title: 導師桌上名牌反扣
cards.whisper: 名字都反扣了，沒人再叫對你。
cards.whisper_en: All the names are turned face-down, no one will call you right again.

edits.corridor: At the far dark end of the long wet corridor beyond the fluorescent tube lights, add a distant dark adult silhouette with its back turned, and stretch long shadows of a whole seated class across the wet reflective floor with nobody casting them.
edits.door: Hang a white short-sleeved school shirt with navy trim on the wooden classroom door with the small square window, and turn every pair of white sneakers in the wooden shoe cubby and the pair before the door to face the camera, leaving one cubby compartment empty.
edits.classroom: Push every wood-veneer student desk with steel legs away from one single desk left alone in the center, turn every wooden chair to face the camera, drape a white short-sleeved school shirt with navy trim over every chair back, and scatter blank face-down name cards patched with tape across the top of the teacher's wooden desk beside the canvas tote and stack of books and onto the floor below it.

cards.title: 排名掉滿公布欄下
cards.whisper: 掉下來的名字，還在看你。
cards.whisper_en: The fallen names are still watching you.

edits.corridor: At the far dark end of the long corridor beyond the fluorescent tube lights, add a distant dark adult silhouette with its back turned standing in the darkness, its reflection visible on the wet reflective terrazzo floor; leave the stone wash-trough, taps, red bucket with mop, and white shirt hanging on the barred window unchanged.
edits.door: On the cork bulletin board beside the wooden classroom door, leave only a few crooked blank white slips pinned up and scatter many fallen blank white ranking slips across the wet reflective floor beneath the board in front of the wooden shoe cabinet with white sneakers; add the long shadows of a whole class stretched across the wet floor with nobody casting them.
edits.classroom: Push every wood-veneer student desk with steel legs to the sides away from one lone desk left alone in the center, turn every wooden chair to face the camera, and hang a white short-sleeved school shirt with navy trim on every chair back, leaving the green chalkboard, teacher's wooden desk with canvas tote and stacked books, wall fans, CRT TV, and rice cooker in place.

memories: 總是叫錯我名字的導師
貼在公布欄上的月考排名
memories_en: the big banyan tree at the end of the corridor
the homeroom teacher who always got my name wrong
the monthly exam rankings posted on the bulletin board
changes_en: Desk cards taped out of order
ending.comment: 昨晚的風我也感覺到了，你的名字我終於念對，榜單之外，老師有看見你。
ending.comment_en: I felt last night's wind too. I finally get your name right — beyond the rankings, I saw you.
